title: Bind a physical four-ADD boundary and save 6,144 CNOTs
body:
## Summary

Bind the completed physical operators of the frozen forward A13-A16 block to a quarter grid and `P+5` signed bits, then share its source sign-fill guard across four half-ADDs.

```text
four separate PR3081 calls: (fill; ADD; unfill) x 4
shared caller:              fill; ADD x 4; unfill

P=64, W=69              CNOTs      Toffolis    Array bits + carry
separate baseline      1,130,496     557,056          353,281
shared guard           1,124,352     557,056          353,281
saving                     6,144           0                0
```

Only `research/rank7-physical-a13/` is added. [Proof, source pins, reproduction and remaining obligations](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/19fefab093b802a58d0c432debfa72fa4b381b2d/research/rank7-physical-a13). Follow-up to the [PR3084 physical-producer handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18984243), in the [canonical finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984556).

This is a **local completed-operator/bit-caller result, not a new kappa or supplier admission**. Four rank-one frame climbs remain charged. Preparation and child interiors, routing, stock production, retimed hosting windows and the later fractional-target consumer remain additional obligations. The local bill assumes five appropriately encoded disjoint arrays are available. No unknown cost is treated as zero.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3084 explicitly omitted physical frame conversion; PR3081 emitted separate guarded calls. The scalar half-grid at A13 is insufficient for its physical target.
  **After:** exact native replay binds both frozen providers, every paid climb/warp/ADD in the group, 4,096 real rows and all 512 Gaussian columns of the source/target/closure operators, including phases. A unit input produces `1/4`; a P=5 witness needs encoded value 270 where one less bit permits 255.
- Both serialized circuit versions are executed by packed-bit and independent bit-array evaluators on 15,360 four-target component cases. Their entire final bit states agree, including restored source and carry. Thirteen behavioral groups cover signed boundaries, missing fill/cleanup, dirty carry, phase, literal chronology, source corruption and occupied output.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized checks, Python 3.13 equality, Git-free export replay, lint/format/source compilation and all 25 committed-file byte checks pass locally. Hosted CI and independent human/formal review are separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-physical-a13
```

`RUN` is an existing external session directory with `tmp/`. Standard library only. Base is canonical main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6, unchanged at refresh. The original `independent-moment` card is explicitly changed to the released physical-boundary handoff, not another root calculation.

Credit PR3084/3083, PR3081/3080/3078, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis/PR2226, icekylinx and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. MAJ/UMA addition is due to Cuccaro, Draper, Kutin and Moulton. Frozen source notices remain unchanged. No priority is claimed for generic guard sharing. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

New opt-in research package only. Shared code, scientific source archives, priorities and the selected frontier are unchanged.
